graders.evidence:
# acme-tool — architecture overview

source: cf97c09 · reviewed: 2026-09-17

## What this is

`acme-tool` is a Node.js package (`package.json:1`) that declares one npm-installable binary,
`acme` (`package.json` `bin.acme` → `src/cli/main.js`). Classification is **ambiguous between
`cli` and `service`**: the `bin` entry says CLI, the `express` dependency says service
(`docs/architecture/_run/gaps.json` id `kind-ambiguous`). This document treats it as a CLI whose
entry point also wires in a web-framework import, per the skill's tie-break default — see
`docs/architecture/_run/interview.md` for the open question. Confidence: **code** for structure and imports below;
**GAP** for anything about intent, since there is no README, no tests, and no comments in the
source to state intent.

## Components (`docs/reference/components.md`, `docs/architecture/model/generated.c4`)

| component | files | kind (assigned) | role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cli` | 1 (`src/cli/main.js`) | cli | process entry point; the only file with no importers |
| `core` | 2 (`src/core/run.js`, `src/core/back.js`) | service | holds `run()`, the one piece of business logic |
| `web` | 1 (`src/web/server.js`) | service (overridden from the extractor's default `webui` — see below) | wraps `express`, reads one env var |

The `web` component was auto-classified `webui` by the folder-name heuristic; it is relabelled
`service` here (`docs/architecture/fold-rules.json` `kinds.web`) because `docs/reference/ui.json`
shows zero routes and zero `data-*` attributes, and `src/web/server.js` never calls `express()` or
`.listen()` — there is no browser-facing surface to map. See "What actually runs" below.

## What actually runs

Tracing `src/cli/main.js:1` line by line:
1. it imports `run` from `src/core/run.js`, `serve` from `src/web/server.js`, and the `express`
   package.
2. `run()` is called — `src/core/run.js:1` returns the constant `1`. No side effects.
3. `serve(express)` is called — `src/web/server.js:1` ignores its argument and calls `run()` again,
   returning `1` again.

**GAP / finding:** `express` is imported in two places (`src/cli/main.js:1`, transitively
`src/web/server.js`) but `express()` is never invoked anywhere in the repository, so no HTTP
server, route, or listener is ever created. The dependency is exercised only as an unused
function-argument value. Nothing in the current code makes this a running "web service" — see
`docs/architecture/deployment.md` and `docs/architecture/_run/review.md`.

## The import cycle

`src/core/back.js:1` — it imports `serve` from `src/web/server.js` and re-exports it as `back` —
creates the `core → web` edge. `src/web/server.js:1` imports `src/core/run.js`, creating `web → core`.
Together these form the one cycle the extractor found (`docs/reference/components.md`,
`docs/architecture/model/generated.c4`: `core<->web` 1 import each way).

**GAP / finding:** no file in the repository imports `src/core/back.js`. It is not reachable from
`src/cli/main.js`, the package's only declared entry point. The cycle exists solely because of this
one unreferenced file — see `docs/architecture/risks.md`.

## Dependencies (`docs/reference/deps.md`)

| name | version | import site | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `express` | `^4.19.0` | `src/cli/main.js` | imported, never invoked (see above) |
| `leftpad` | `^1.3.0` | none | declared, unused — flagged by the kit (`deps-unused-leftpad`) |

No lockfile is committed, so the resolved versions actually installed are a GAP.

## Delivery (`docs/reference/delivery.md`, `docs/architecture/risks.md`)

One GitHub Actions workflow, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, one job (`test`, `ubuntu-latest`), one
step: `npm test`. `package.json` declares no `scripts` block at all, so `npm test` fails with
`npm error Missing script: "test"` on every push (verified by running it in this checkout,
exit code 1). The pipeline as committed cannot currently pass — see `docs/architecture/risks.md`.

## Risks, secrets, signals, quality, stakeholders

Split into their own files per the house style: `docs/architecture/risks.md`,
`docs/architecture/secrets.md`, `docs/architecture/signals.md`, `docs/architecture/quality.md`,
`docs/architecture/stakeholders.md`, `docs/architecture/glossary.md`,
`docs/architecture/deployment.md`, `docs/architecture/scenarios/`, `docs/architecture/journeys/`.

## What could not be determined from the code

- Intent: whether `acme-tool` is meant to become a real HTTP service, a pure CLI, or both — GAP,
  see `docs/architecture/_run/interview.md` (`kind-ambiguous`).
- Whether the `core<->web` cycle and `src/core/back.js` are intentional scaffolding or leftover
  code — GAP, see `docs/architecture/_run/interview.md` (`import-cycle-core-web`).
- Any deployment target, runtime environment, or hosting arrangement — no Dockerfile, IaC, or
  deploy step exists in this checkout — GAP, see `docs/architecture/deployment.md`.
- Rendered C4 views: this environment has no network access to fetch the LikeC4 renderer, so
  `docs/reference/views/*.png` were not produced this run — GAP, see `docs/architecture/_run/kit-issues.md`.
- Anything about who owns this code, why it exists, or committed history beyond one `init` commit
  — GAP, see `docs/architecture/stakeholders.md`.
